fields.statement: Built rhiza at HEAD fe4c76490 (go build -trimpath); `rhiza guide verifier | grep '^#'` prints exactly six ## sections (Task, Expected outcome, Read first, Must do, Must not do, Context), with Command budget and Never nested as ###. The cycle-1 eight-section defect is fixed. The text has the detached checkout, Checks:/acceptance re-run, fakes only, Never edit code, the Evidence apply example and the rhiza run findings heredoc. The installed rhiza-verifier SKILL.md has the same six ## headings. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... ok

`rhiza guide builder` (built at HEAD) prints six ## sections in order, with Command budget, Outside work and Never as ###, no unexpanded shared markers, the Checks: block example above the trailer paragraph, the actor-record git add line, and the RHIZA_ATTEMPT > 1 rule naming /rhiza-build-retry and rhiza guide build-retry. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... ok

`rhiza guide build-retry` (built at HEAD) prints a 192-token topic: inspect the working tree and earlier commits, read findings from the prompt or rhiza run status --json, address every finding exactly as written, one fix commit with the same Leaf: trailer, never rewrite history. `rhiza guide ls` lists it. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... ok

With the built binary in a scratch repo (HOME isolated), `rhiza guide install --agent claude` wrote skills/rhiza-builder, rhiza-verifier, rhiza-build-retry and rhiza-build SKILL.md (10 written); re-running reported 0 written, 10 unchanged. `rhiza guide build` is a short index naming /rhiza-builder, /rhiza-build-retry and /rhiza-verifier and their rhiza guide routes. go test ./internal/api -run GuideInstall ok; TestScripts/(guide|guide-install|build-evidence-commit) ok

`rhiza guide builder` and `rhiza guide verifier` (built at HEAD) print the shared test-scope, unstable-ci, command-budget, outside-work, never-list and session-done text expanded, with zero `<!--` markers left in output or in the installed SKILL.md files. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... ok

`rhiza workflow describe build` (built at HEAD) shows the builder prompt `/rhiza-builder Build leaf {leaf} of change set {change} ({title}), attempt {attempt}: follow rhiza guide builder.` and the verifier one-liner; `workflow describe review` shows the same verifier line. .rhiza/workflows/docs-build.toml starts the builder prompt with the builtin line plus the humanize addendum; docs-review.toml's verifier prompt is byte-identical. go test ./internal/workflow/... ok; TestScripts/(build-evidence-commit|docs-commands-exist) ok
